curriculum.subject: English Language Activities
curriculum.outcomeText: write from left to right for lifelong learning

interactions.prompt: Where should your pencil start when writing the word cat?
interactions.feedback: Yes! English writing starts on the left.
interactions.retryHint: Point to the side where this sentence begins.

interactions.prompt: Tap the letters in the order we write cat from left to right.
interactions.feedback: Great! c, a, t travels from left to right.
interactions.retryHint: Say cat slowly, then begin with c.

interactions.prompt: Trace the word sun from the starting dot on the left.
interactions.feedback: Smooth tracing! Your pencil moved left to right.
interactions.retryHint: Return to s on the left, then move through u to n.

interactions.prompt: Which row shows the correct left-to-right order for dog?
interactions.feedback: Correct! Begin with d on the left and finish with g on the right.
interactions.retryHint: Spell dog aloud and follow the letters in that order.

interactions.prompt: Arrange these word cards to write: I see a hen.
interactions.feedback: Lovely writing order! The sentence moves from I on the left to hen on the right.
interactions.retryHint: Start with the capital I, then say the sentence slowly.

interactions.prompt: Show the direction used to write an English sentence.
interactions.feedback: Excellent! We write from left to right.
interactions.retryHint: Think of where your pencil starts and where it finishes.
